name: Gouguo
description: A star 138 parsecs away, 127 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.

radius.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 98688: radius 127.225 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 2214.86 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.075) and temperature

temperature.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 98688: effective temperature 3513 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.259)

gravity.source: SIMBAD's compilation of spectroscopic measurements (mesFe_h): log g 0.28 from 2023ApJS..266...11B; the 1 published value span log g 0.278 to 0.278, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.0% of the centre brightness

distance.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 98688: distance 137.552 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.025), at which the luminosity and radius hold

text.card: A star 138 parsecs away, 127 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.
text.introduction: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 2,215 times the Sun's luminosity at 3,513 K, so 127.225 solar radii.
